name: Tovolar
aliases: alpha werewolf of the Mondronen howlpack
description: Tovolar is a huge silver-furred werewolf of Innistrad, former alpha of the Mondronen howlpack and Arlinn Kord's old mentor, who leads a new pack of dire werewolves.

summary.text: Tovolar is a huge silver-furred werewolf of Innistrad, former alpha of the Mondronen howlpack and Arlinn Kord's old mentor, who leads a new pack of dire werewolves.

citations.text: "Tovolar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Tovolar took the new werewolf Arlinn under his tutelage to teach her to embrace her nature.

citations.text: "Tovolar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Arlinn Kord", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: They fell out when she refused to join the slaughter of foresters, and she challenged him for command of the howlpack, wounded him and fled.

citations.text: "Tovolar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Arlinn Kord", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Years later he formed a growing pack of dire werewolves and planned to unify the howlpacks and take the nights as well as the woods.

citations.text: "Tovolar", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citations.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

bio.text: Arlinn's own wolves sided with him, and he launched a full-scale attack on the Harvesttide festival.

citations.text: "Tovolar", section "Harvesttide Massacre". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Tovolar", section "Harvesttide Massacre". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Arlinn feigned surrender and severely wounded him, and he agreed to call off the attack and retreated with the pack.

citations.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

bio.text: Later he led his wolves to help Arlinn against Olivia Voldaren at Voldaren Manor, though she said nothing had changed between them.

citations.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

status.text: After the Voldaren fight he and Arlinn parted ways with their grievance unresolved, and his howlpack has scattered though the dire-strain survivors still hunt.

citations.text: "Tovolar", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Wolf Strike (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A shaman calls Tovolar to gather the howlpack for the Hunter's Moon as Thraben's walls weaken.
timeline.quote: Gather the howlpack, for the Hunter's Moon is nigh and Thraben's walls grow weak.

citation.text: Mondronen Shaman (Dark Ascension, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As a teenager Arlinn is summoned by Tovolar's pack's howls and completes her First Hunt.
timeline.quote: Arlinn was a teenager from Avabruck when the howls of Tovolar 's Mondronen werewolf pack summoned her into the forest and she completed her First Hunt.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn rejects Tovolar's urging to slaughter foresters, fights him and abandons the pack.
timeline.quote: Arlinn rejected that idea and fought Tovolar, leaving lasting scars on them both.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn recalls sparing a white stag and finding a skull left by Tovolar the next morning (flashback).
timeline.quote: there was a skull before them, resting atop a sword driven into the ground

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: A rough, deep howl interrupts them, and Arlinn recognizes it as Tovolar's.
timeline.quote: A howl, rough and deep.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: In a flashback Arlinn, after her first change, sits with Tovolar, who tells her the woods belong to them; she suggests they could share them with the Kessigers.
timeline.quote: "These woods belong to us," he told her.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn remembers hearing Tovolar's howl as a girl and leaving her walled-in village at night for a life without fear.
timeline.quote: Under cover of night, she left.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn finds Tovolar surrounded by huge wolves who have changed early, and asks who the newcomers are.
timeline.quote: "Who are these guys?"

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: In a flashback Tovolar shows young Arlinn three torn-apart hunters and tells her that being free is worth whatever it costs.
timeline.quote: "Being free is worth whatever we pay for it," he answered.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sees that the wolves gathered around Tovolar are a new pack, not his old Mondronen one, and that something bigger than a hunt is being prepared.
timeline.quote: "Family," he answers. "Our new pack."

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar reveals he is getting ready to take the nights as well as the woods, hunting vampires and anyone else.
timeline.quote: "Getting ready to take what's ours," he says.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn refuses to accept that wolves can do whatever they want, and Tovolar scorns her for having too much church in her.
timeline.quote: "Too much church in you," he growls. "Too little wolf."

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn raises a claw to strike Tovolar to delay his plans, but Boulder jumps in front of him and she pulls back.
timeline.quote: But before it can make contact, Boulder's in motion, jumping in front of him.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: In a flashback Arlinn finds refuge in the church, where friends help her feel safe, until Tovolar comes to morning services and sits beside her.
timeline.quote: Until he showed up to morning services.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sends Patience to join Tovolar so she can stay with the wolves and keep them safe.
timeline.quote: "Keep everyone safe," she says.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar invites Arlinn to find him when she is ready for the new world and begins to shift; she leaves.
timeline.quote: Tovolar nods. "When you're ready for the new world, come find us."

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Howlpack shamans and hundreds of wolves attack the barriers while the witches usher the festivalgoers toward the center of the Celestus.
timeline.quote: doesn't see them beating against the barriers until the shaman-wolves are already upon them

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The magical barrier shatters and the wall of werewolves crashes into the festivalgoers.
timeline.quote: Overhead, the magic shatters like stained glass

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn remembers that after two years under Tovolar's tutelage she left him scarred and bleeding and ran away in the night.
timeline.quote: she left him scarred and bleeding then ran away in the middle of the night

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn confronts Tovolar and demands he call off the raid; he refuses.
timeline.quote: He smirks, shakes his head. "No."

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn attacks Tovolar with a mace, which he catches and tears from her hands.
timeline.quote: Tovolar catches the head of the mace.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn punches Tovolar and offers to let him take the nights back if he spares the humans, but he rejects it.
timeline.quote: Take the nights back, hunt what you can, but leave the humans out of this.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar transforms and presses her; Arlinn takes a sword from a fallen guard and Tovolar claws her cheek.
timeline.quote: his claws tear open her cheek.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn recalls the night she challenged Tovolar for the alpha position and the scar she gave him.
timeline.quote: And then she'd be the alpha of the howlpack.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar pins Arlinn and demands she show him the real Arlinn; the sun sets and Arlinn changes into a wolf.
timeline.quote: The sun sinks below the horizon. Day changes to night.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar's howlpack grows bolder, smarter and stronger.
timeline.quote: Tovolar's howlpack was getting bolder, smarter, and stronger.

citation.text: Foul Play (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tovolar's howl is answered from inside the Harvesttide festival.
timeline.quote: When Tovolar's howl sounded from the woods, it was answered from the heart of the festival.

citation.text: Harvesttide Assailant (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Barnes describes Tovolar's cunning campaign of terror.
timeline.quote: This Tovolar is no brainless brute.

citation.text: Lambholt Harrier (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tovolar joins the fray and cathars fall.
timeline.quote: The cathars fell like leaves as Tovolar himself joined the fray.

citation.text: Moonrager's Slash (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tovolar's howl compels Arlinn's own pack to betray her.
timeline.quote: Tovolar's howl of command was too much to resist, even for Arlinn's own loyal pack.

citation.text: Pack's Betrayal (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Witch, werewolf and cathar defend the Sungold Lock against Tovolar's assault.
timeline.quote: Witch, werewolf, and cathar stood shoulder to shoulder around the Sungold Lock at the center of the ritual, ready to stop Tovolar's assault—or die trying.

citation.text: Defend the Celestus (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tovolar attacks the Harvesttide festival; Teferi delays the sunset and cathars led by Adeline fight the werewolves.
timeline.quote: Tovolar began his attack on the Harvesttide festival

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tovolar invites Arlinn to a mass human hunt; she refuses and tries to attack him, and her wolves side with Tovolar.
timeline.quote: Tovolar invites Arlinn to join him and other werewolves in a massive human hunt in Kessig .

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tovolar's army attacks the Harvesttide festival and the planeswalkers, cathars and witches fight the werewolves.
timeline.quote: Cathars, witches and planeswalkers fought the werewolves to protect the humans .

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn feigns surrender and overpowers Tovolar, who retreats with the pack.
timeline.quote: Arlinn feigned surrender, but then overpowered the unsuspecting Tovolar with a deathgrip in his chest.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tovolar's howlpack attacks the festival; the Gatewatch helps and Teferi slows the sunset.
timeline.quote: Teferi slowed the sunset

citation.text: "Dawnhart Coven", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn feigns surrender and overpowers Tovolar, who retreats with the pack.
timeline.quote: Arlinn feigned surrender, but then overpowered the unsuspecting Tovolar

citation.text: "Dawnhart Coven", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tovolar's werewolves attack the barrier around the festival, and the Gatewatch helps the witches.
timeline.quote: In human form, hundreds of werewolves attacked the magical barrier put up around the festival.

citation.text: "Harvesttide Festival", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn faces Tovolar and changes form when night falls.
timeline.quote: When the night finally fell, Arlinn changed form.

citation.text: "Harvesttide Festival", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn feigns surrender then overpowers Tovolar, who retreats with his pack.
timeline.quote: Arlinn feigned surrender, but then overpowered the unsuspecting Tovolar with a death grip around his chest.

citation.text: "Harvesttide Festival", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tovolar attacks the festival; Kaya brings the Key to Katilda and the ritual begins.
timeline.quote: Kaya 's intangibility let her run through the attack to bring the Key to Katilda

citation.text: "Katilda", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tovolar's howlpack attacks the festival while Kaya delivers the Key to Katilda.
timeline.quote: Kaya delivered the Key to Katilda

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Twenty years ago Tovolar takes the new werewolf Arlinn Kord under his tutelage to teach her to embrace her nature.
timeline.quote: She came under his tutelage

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn and Tovolar fall out when she refuses to join in slaughtering foresters; she challenges him for command of the howlpack, they wound each other and she flees.
timeline.quote: Arlinn turned on her mentor, challenging Tovolar for command of the howlpack

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Two years after the Travails, Tovolar forms a growing pack of dire werewolves and plans to unify all howlpacks under his rule.
timeline.quote: Tovolar formed a new pack of dire werewolves that was growing rapidly

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn brings the Moonsilver Key to the Celestus, but Tovolar launches a full-scale attack on the Harvesttide Festival.
timeline.quote: Tovolar launched a full-scale attack upon the festival

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "Harvesttide Massacre". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn confronts Tovolar, who refuses to stop and urges her to join him; they fight until Tovolar calls on the wolves of her old pack and overpowers her.
timeline.quote: Tovolar refused and goaded Arlinn

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "Harvesttide Massacre". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn's wolf pack joins Tovolar, except Patience; Arlinn feigns surrender, then severely wounds Tovolar, who retreats with the pack.
timeline.quote: Arlinn feigned surrender, but then overpowered the unsuspecting Tovolar and severely wounded him

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "Harvesttide Massacre". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn, in wolf form, attacks Tovolar at the festival and he throws her to the ground.
timeline.quote: Forward. Powerful legs send her flying through the air

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar slams Arlinn into a split tree trunk, and she tears out a piece of wood and drives it through his leg.
timeline.quote: she has pierced him all the way through

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Streak, Redtooth and Boulder pin Arlinn down, and she is stunned by a blow to the head.
timeline.quote: there is Streak with his jaws firmly locked on her already wounded shoulder

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar urges Arlinn to join the hunt and says that the Church hates part of her but the pack does not.
timeline.quote: "Join the hunt," he says.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Tovolar she is home so he lets her up, then drives her claws into his sternum.
timeline.quote: She drives her claws deep into his sternum.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Tovolar Innistrad is home, and he calls her a liar.
timeline.quote: "You lied," he rasps.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar agrees to call off the attack, and the wolves howl a retreat.
timeline.quote: The howl goes up soon after that, a call for retreat only the wolves understand.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn reaches the ballroom, sees Sigarda reaping vampires, and spares a Markov duelist rather than kill him as Tovolar would.
timeline.quote: Arlinn hefts him overhead and hurls him into a column.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar's howlpack scatters but the Dire-Strain survivors still hunt.
timeline.quote: Tovolar's howlpack had scattered, but the Dire-Strain survivors were still on the hunt.

citation.text: Wolf Strike (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tovolar and his wolves arrive to help, and with the Key secured Teferi speeds the journey back to complete the ritual and restore balance.
timeline.quote: Tovolar and his wolves arrived to help

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tovolar and the pack arrive to help; Olivia drops the Key and flees with Edgar.
timeline.quote: Olivia dropped the Moonsilver Key and left with Edgar through one of the broken windows, barely escaping from the jaws of Tovolar.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn and her pack find Olivia and Edgar, who escape through a broken window.
timeline.quote: Olivia dropped the Moonsilver Key in defeat and escaped with Edgar

citation.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key in defeat and escapes with Edgar.
timeline.quote: Olivia dropped the Moonsilver Key in defeat and escaped with Edgar through one of the broken windows.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gravely injured by Olivia, Arlinn calls for aid and Tovolar leads his wolves into battle in answer.
timeline.quote: Tovolar answered the call and led his wolves into battle

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn accepts Tovolar's help tracking Olivia though nothing has changed between them; they find Olivia with Edgar Markov.
timeline.quote: Arlinn accepted his help to track down Olivia

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key and flees with Edgar through a window; Arlinn and Tovolar part ways unresolved.
timeline.quote: Olivia dropped the Moonsilver Key and fled with Edgar through one of the windows

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A massive wolf blocks a javelin and dozens of wolves pour into the ballroom, led by Tovolar, who nods that he is here to help.
timeline.quote: There must be dozens of wolves pouring in now

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya points Tovolar to the door where Arlinn went, and he bounds toward her.
timeline.quote: Tovolar's gone the second she's done talking

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn dreams of forests and wakes to find Tovolar and her four wolves around her.
timeline.quote: When she opens her eyes, Tovolar is the first thing she sees

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Tovolar their grievance is unsettled and he proposes that they settle it afterward.
timeline.quote: "Tovolar," she says, "this doesn't change anything between us.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn and her wolves track Olivia and corner her with Edgar, and Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key and flees.
timeline.quote: But she drops the key.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn takes the key in her teeth and tells Tovolar to come find her later.
timeline.quote: Arlinn wraps the key with a length of torn curtain and picks it up between her teeth.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: On the journey from Stensia to Kessig, Arlinn tells Katilda about Tovolar and werewolf fear and how Harvesttide set things back.
timeline.quote: "It isn't until you get some distance that you realize they're wrong.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Boulder joins Arlinn's pack on a hunt, then the pack meets Tovolar, who reveals plans for a new, more aggressive pack; Boulder pledges allegiance to Tovolar, leaving Arlinn betrayed.
timeline.quote: Boulder showed his allegiance to Tovolar

citation.text: "Boulder", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Boulder forcefully pushes Arlinn as she resists Tovolar's call, breaking her ribs.
timeline.quote: Boulder forcefully pushed her, breaking her ribs

citation.text: "Boulder", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn wakes injured with Tovolar and her wolves, Boulder included, at her side.
timeline.quote: Boulder and the others assisted her

citation.text: "Boulder", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Boulder rejoins Arlinn in Thraben Cathedral and helps her to her feet as she faces Tovolar.
timeline.quote: helping them to her feet and staying close

timeline.summary: Olivia stages a wedding with Edgar Markov to control Innistrad; Sorin, the Gatewatch, Sigarda and Tovolar's werewolves foil her and many Voldaren die.

timeline.summary: Arlinn remembers Worrin's advice to tend one's own light and that he recommended her for the Archmagi, strengthening her against Tovolar's temptations.
